capabilities: Close selected groups of tabs in batches
Filter tabs by path, file name, extension, or view type
Save and reorder reusable search groups
Reopen tabs from a Recently closed history
Protect pinned and active tabs from closing
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; designed for desktop and mobile but only tested on macOS. README includes backup warnings and release-attestation details. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to see all open tabs at once and close many of them—such as empty or duplicate tabs—in one reviewed batch.

relations.evidence: The product concept was inspired by Tab Out.

summary: Visual panel for reviewing, filtering, and safely closing groups of Obsidian tabs, with a reopenable history of cleanup batches.
